recap.narration_text: Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: signs, signals and pavement markings. regulatory. enforcement. Traffic-control devices include signs, signals and pavement markings that regulate road traffic. A driver must recognize traffic controls promptly and obey regulatory signs. Traffic directions given by law-enforcement officers, highway personnel and school crossing guards must be obeyed.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: ahead. require. diamonds. Warning signs alert a driver to possible danger, a hazard or a special roadway situation ahead. A warning may require slowing and being ready to stop. Warning signs are usually yellow diamonds with black lettering or symbols.

Keep these reminders connected to their full rules: traffic speed. white. permitted. On a multilane highway, Slower Traffic Keep Right directs vehicles below the normal traffic speed to the right lane. The Do Not Enter design has a white horizontal bar inside a red circle and prohibits entering the roadway opening. A Wrong Way sign indicates that the vehicle is already traveling against the permitted direction.
